1. Simple & elegant UI/UX
2. Ball by ball scoring
3. Undo any mistaken inputs
4. Full scorecard (Batting, Bowling, Fall of Wickets, etc.)
5. Individual player statistics
6. Resume any match from where you left. (Auto saves match state)
7. Digital Wallet to maintain cash that you earn
9. Most Valuable Player (MVP)
10. Best batting and bowling performances
